ENGLISH MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ENGLISH MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes ● formation of nouns (nouns formed from other .

2. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. Many unrelated topics with no link

3. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. happiness
   C. blue
   D. run

4. When practising Reading 1.2.1 Reading Fluency: Argumentative texts, which approach is best? (1 mark)

5. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)

   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening ● finding connections between id.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Critical Listening ● finding connections between id.

7. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. Only an action
   D. A person, place, thing, or idea

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the Library
   B. Where is the library?

   D. where is the library
